results.title: At Lord’s, Mandaviya pushes for 2036 Olympics in India
results.description: Mandaviya, who was in UK for the inauguration of the Commonwealth Games, was greeted for a tour of the world-famous stadium and exhibits, including the Prudential Trophy and the Ashes

results.title: Visiting UN chief urges respect for Syria's sovereignty and international support
results.description: Guterres is the first UN chief to visit Syria since his predecessor Ban Ki-moon in 2009, two years before the start of Syria's war, which went on to kill more than half a million people.
